protocol.direct_recursive_definition: same parent slope applied once from N=1024 to each N >= 1280 as a composition identity control
protocol.horizon_localization_definition: first predeclared horizon whose absolute parent forecast error exceeds 0.03
protocol.local_control_definition: current-family N=1024 mean times (N/1024) to current-family 1024 -> 1280 slope
protocol.parent_transfer_definition: current-family N=1024 mean times (N/1024) to frozen parent TPC390 slope
protocol.recursive_parent_definition: for N >= 1280, current-family N=1024 mean, staged through N=1280, using frozen parent TPC390 slope
